findings: The methods identify the trial as NCT01888484, whereas the data-sharing statement identifies NCT02320305. The discrepancy is preserved and not silently corrected.

The abstract describes 0.083 per infusion as the rate of adverse drug reactions, while the safety results describe 0.083 per infusion as the rate of all treatment-emergent adverse events excluding local reactions and infections; related systemic adverse events were reported separately at 0.0023 per infusion. The terminology inconsistency is preserved.

extraction_limitations: All atoms remain needs_review because no human source-verification step is represented.
The study is a pediatric subanalysis of a single-arm trial; comparative claims against IVIG or the general pediatric population are interpretation rather than randomized comparative evidence.
Figure 3 and Figure 4 are represented with source-described patterns rather than digitized point estimates because exact plotted values were not reported numerically in the figure text.
No external current-practice, regulatory, or registry verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
